limits: Explicit auth SQL stand-in; no GoTrue login, email or real issuance.
Synthetic paid/delivered rows are not a financial purchase-flow test.
No app/device/cache renderer or ability to recall delivered push.
No hosted access, build, OTA, web or Play.
